title: A Shoot from the Stump
paragraphs: Isaiah also saw something sad: the royal family tree cut down to a stump, like a tree after a storm. Yet he promised that from the stump a new green shoot would grow. A child of Jesse's family, wise and fair, who would care for the poor. And a peace so deep that wolves would lie down with lambs and a little child would lead them. He also spoke of a baby with a name that means God with us: Immanuel. Look at an old tree stump in the woods: sometimes a green shoot does appear. God's hope often arrives small and green, in the places we thought were finished.
wonder: I wonder what a world where wolves and lambs are friends would be like?
activity: Plant a seed or a bulb (or draw a stump with a green shoot) and watch for growth.
prayer: God of new beginnings, bring green shoots to the places in our lives that feel cut down. Amen.
alt: A green shoot grows from a tree stump, with a wolf and a lamb resting peacefully beside it.
hidden: A tiny bird nesting in the shoot.
translation: Retold in our own words, following the World English Bible.
